description: Get the credits an audio create request charges. Pass `tool`, then the field below that the tool's create request uses. Does not create a project or spend credits. It prices the fields passed here. It does not check your plan, your balance or the rest of the create request.

character_count.description: The number of characters in the `style.prompt` of the create request. Used by `ai-voice-generator`, `ai-voice-cloner`.

duration.description: The `duration` of the create request. Used by `ai-music-generator`.

tool.description: The create endpoint to price, named by its path. For example `ai-voice-generator` for `POST /v1/ai-voice-generator`.

name: estimate_audio

estimated_credits.description: Credits a create request with these fields charges.

title: Estimate audio credits
